title: 第8章 你在激动什么？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

男人很快就没了生机，瘫在地上犹如一滩烂泥。

大大的眼睛还睁着，已经失焦。

司陇强撑把自己挪到一边，侧过头去似乎不愿看到这些。

忽然胃里一阵翻涌。

刚刚一阵风吹来，血肉模糊混合着地上湿漉漉的灰尘味道，像带着肉腥的铁锈味。

第一次闻到，这种味道。

她感觉到自己右臂肌肉还在轻微抖动着，低头看向自己的右手，指缝里全是血。

世界忽然变得很安静，只剩下自己的呼吸声。

她下意识地移开了视线，可余光还是能看见男人摊在一边，一动不动地手。

其实后面一直在逃向边界时，她都没想过要杀掉对方。

真正动了杀心的念头是在即将跨越边界的一瞬间产生的。

即使这一次活了下来，那下一次呢？

下一次自己还能有如此运气吗。

她只是想活下来。

为了好好地活着，只能杜绝一切可能产生的后患。

她扫视着四周陌生而又光怪陆离的环境，第一次开始对自己也陌生起来。

“深眠，派人来接我。”

这次深眠的响应很快。

“好的，司陇副主任。已成功定位到您当前位置，检测到您有失血过多的数据正在上传，已安排随行医务人员，预计五分钟内到达您所在位置。”

很快三辆带着永夜局标识的车驶来，第一辆车刚停下，还没停稳，一个中年男人就快速冲下车向司陇跑来。

他带着一脸哭相，正是她的实习助手，周世通。

“司副主任您没事吧？我担心死了，好端端的怎么突然在办公室中就消失了......哎呀这身上怎么还插着合金矢，这玩意不好拔出来，得回去处理。快快快，担架抬过来！还有你们，快把现场围起来。”

一队工作人员过来迅速拉上警戒条，录像拍照采样，有序地开始处理起地上的尸体。

司陇侧躺着上了担架被抬上后面的救护车。

一直紧绷着的神经猛然放松后，她感受到深深的疲倦感袭来，伴随着周世通一直絮絮叨叨的说话声中，就这样沉沉的睡着了。

再次醒来时，耳边充斥着各种金属工具碰撞的操作声，还有类似仪器滴答滴答的声音。

极强的直射光线刺得她有些睁不开眼。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The man soon lost his life and collapsed on the ground like a puddle of mud.

The big eyes are still open, but they are out of focus.

Si Long forced himself to move aside and turned his head as if he didn't want to see this.

Suddenly my stomach lurched.

A gust of wind had just blown by, and the smell of blood and flesh mixed with the wet dust on the ground was like the smell of fleshy rust.

First time smelling this smell.

She felt that the muscles in her right arm were still shaking slightly. She looked down at her right hand and saw blood between her fingers.

The world suddenly became very quiet, leaving only the sound of my own breathing.

She subconsciously looked away, but she could still see the man's motionless hands spread out from the corner of her eye.

In fact, when she was running towards the border, she never thought about killing him.

The real murderous thoughts came to me at the moment when I was about to cross the border.

Even if you survive this time, what about next time?

Will I be so lucky next time?

She just wants to survive.

In order to live well, we can only eliminate all possible consequences.

She glanced at the unfamiliar and bizarre environment around her, and for the first time she became unfamiliar with herself.

"Deep sleep, send someone to pick me up."

This time Deep Sleep responded quickly.

"Okay, Deputy Director Si Long. Your current location has been successfully located. The data indicating that you have suffered excessive blood loss is being uploaded. Medical personnel have been arranged to accompany you and are expected to arrive at your location within five minutes."

Soon three cars with the Yongye Bureau logo arrived. As soon as the first car stopped, a middle-aged man quickly got out of the car and ran towards Si Long.

With a crying look on his face, he was none other than her intern assistant, Zhou Shitong.

"Deputy Director, are you okay? I'm worried to death. Why did you suddenly disappear in the office? Oh, why is there still an alloy arrow stuck in your body? It's hard to pull it out. You have to go back and deal with it. Quick, quick, bring the stretcher! And you guys, quickly surround the scene."

A team of staff came over and quickly put up security tapes, took videos, photos and samples, and began to deal with the bodies on the ground in an orderly manner.

Si Long was put on a stretcher while lying on his side and was carried to the ambulance behind him.

After her tense nerves suddenly relaxed, she felt a deep sense of fatigue coming over her. With Zhou Shitong's nagging voice, she fell into a deep sleep.

When I woke up again, my ears were filled with the sound of various metal tools colliding with each other, and sounds similar to the ticking of instruments.

The extremely strong direct light made her unable to open her eyes.
